trophies.name: Donkey Kong Bananza Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy in the base game.

trophies.name: Going Underground
trophies.description: Smash your way off the surface and into the first Layer.

trophies.name: The Kid Can Sing
trophies.description: Team up with Pauline.

trophies.name: Go Bananza!
trophies.description: Trigger your first Bananza transformation.

trophies.name: Beast Mode
trophies.description: Unlock Kong Bananza.

trophies.name: Flight of the Kong
trophies.description: Unlock Ostrich Bananza.

trophies.name: Hoof It
trophies.description: Unlock Zebra Bananza.

trophies.name: Whole Zoo Crew
trophies.description: Unlock every Bananza transformation.

trophies.name: Rock Bottom
trophies.description: Reach the Canyon Layer.

trophies.name: Out of the Woods
trophies.description: Reach the Forest Layer.

trophies.name: Halfway Down
trophies.description: Descend past the midpoint of the planet.

trophies.name: To the Core
trophies.description: Reach the planet's core.

trophies.name: Diamond in the Rough
trophies.description: Defeat the leader of VoidCo and finish the story.

trophies.name: Deeper Still
trophies.description: Complete the post-game story content.

trophies.name: Corporate Takedown
trophies.description: Defeat your first VoidCo boss.

trophies.name: Hostile Takeover
trophies.description: Defeat every VoidCo boss.

trophies.name: Flawless Demolition
trophies.description: Defeat any boss without taking damage.

trophies.name: That's Bananas
trophies.description: Collect your first Banandium Gem.

trophies.name: Bunch of Bananas
trophies.description: Collect 100 Banandium Gems.

trophies.name: Top Banana
trophies.description: Collect every Banandium Gem in the game.

trophies.name: Blast from the Past
trophies.description: Dig up your first fossil.

trophies.name: Layer Archaeologist
trophies.description: Give an Elder every fossil from their Layer.

trophies.name: Natural History
trophies.description: Collect every fossil across all Layers.

trophies.name: Talent Scout
trophies.description: Fully fill one branch of the skill tree.

trophies.name: Fully Evolved
trophies.description: Unlock every skill in the skill tree.

trophies.name: Dress for Success
trophies.description: Buy an outfit for DK or Pauline.

trophies.name: Fashion Kong
trophies.description: Collect every outfit.

trophies.name: Challenge Accepted
trophies.description: Clear your first challenge course.

trophies.name: Course Veteran
trophies.description: Clear 10 challenge courses.

trophies.name: No Course Left Behind
trophies.description: Clear every challenge course.

trophies.name: Hang Ten
trophies.description: Ride a torn-up chunk of terrain like a surfboard.

trophies.name: Strike!
trophies.description: Take out three enemies with a single thrown boulder.

trophies.name: Tunnel Vision
trophies.description: Dig straight down through an entire Layer of terrain.

trophies.name: Total Demolition
trophies.description: Completely flatten a large structure.

trophies.name: Fast Travel Network
trophies.description: Activate every Warp Gong.

trophies.name: Two-Kong Combo
trophies.description: Play in two-player co-op with a friend controlling Pauline.

trophies.name: Elder Whisperer
trophies.description: Track down a hidden Elder.

trophies.name: Off the Map
trophies.description: Discover a secret Layer.

trophies.name: Tough as Bedrock
trophies.description: Fully upgrade DK's health.

trophies.name: Absolute Unit
trophies.description: Reach 100% completion of the base game.

trophies.name: Island Getaway
trophies.description: Travel to DK Island and take a job mining for Void Kong.

trophies.name: Sunken Treasure
trophies.description: Pay Squawks to raise your first statue from the sea.

trophies.name: Ahoy, K. Rool
trophies.description: Explore King K. Rool's Gangplank Galleon on DK Island.

trophies.name: Dressed in a Hurry
trophies.description: Solve the Banandiumtone puzzle on the Floating Islet to earn the Quick-Change Tie.

trophies.name: Family Portrait
trophies.description: Use Rambi to summon Diddy, Dixie, and Cranky Kong for a photo.

trophies.name: Going for Gold
trophies.description: Clear your first DK Island bonus stage.

trophies.name: Six for Gold
trophies.description: Clear all six bonus stages: Bouncing, Surfing, Quaking, Bombing, Smashing, and Blasting for Gold.

trophies.name: Well Grounded
trophies.description: Activate all ten DK Island checkpoints.

trophies.name: Back in Business
trophies.description: Earn 2,000 Rating Points so Void restarts the Pay-Dirt Piledriver.

trophies.name: The Gold Standard
trophies.description: Collect all 85 statues and unlock the golden Donkey Kong and Pauline statue.

trophies.name: Void Where Prohibited
trophies.description: Reach 10,000 Rating Points and defeat Void Kong on DK Island.

trophies.name: Rush Job
trophies.description: Complete your first Emerald Rush run.

trophies.name: Meeting Quota
trophies.description: Reach the Void Goal in an Emerald Rush run.

trophies.name: Gusher
trophies.description: Set off an Emerald geyser during a run.

trophies.name: Perk Up
trophies.description: Unlock your first Emerald Perk.

trophies.name: Limited-Time Offer
trophies.description: Take part in a periodic Emerald Rush event.

trophies.name: Fully Perked
trophies.description: Unlock every Emerald Perk.

trophies.name: Beast of the Rush
trophies.description: Clear a Bananza-themed event such as Kong Bananza Returns or Elephant Bananza Stampede.

trophies.name: Event Horizon
trophies.description: Complete every themed Emerald Rush challenge at least once.
